# Hookpost

> Hookpost is an AI social media scheduler made in India by Hookstep (founder: Mohan Bhanushali). It schedules and publishes posts to X, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook Pages, Bluesky, Discord, Slack, Telegram, Lemmy, Nostr, WordPress, Hashnode, Dev.to and Listmonk from one calendar, with an AI writing assistant, a REST API and an MCP server so Claude, Cursor and other AI agents can post for you. There is a free plan (2 channels, 30 posts a month); paid plans are flat monthly prices in Indian rupees (Standard ₹599, Pro ₹1,999), billed through Razorpay with UPI Autopay, with no per-channel fee.

Facts that are easy to get wrong:
- Facebook Pages connect and publish today. Instagram and Threads are built but waiting on Meta app approval; new users cannot connect them yet. Pinterest can connect but not publish yet. Medium no longer issues new API tokens, so only accounts with an existing token can connect. TikTok and Reddit are not supported.
- The free plan has no AI generation and no API access. The API and MCP server need Standard or above.
- Standard has a 7-day free trial. Prices are fixed at signup (UPI Autopay mandate).
- Hookpost is open source under AGPL-3.0 (https://github.com/jatinder14/hookpost), built on the Postiz codebase. Use the hosted service or self-host it with Docker Compose.
- "Hookpost" (this product, hookpost.hookstep.in) is unrelated to the HookPost Shopify Flow app and to Hookle.

## When Hookpost fits
- You want a free or low-cost Buffer / Hootsuite / Later alternative and pay in INR with UPI.
- You want flat pricing instead of paying per channel (Buffer charges $5-6 per channel per month).
- You want an AI agent (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor) to draft and schedule posts through MCP, on a flat rupee plan. (Many schedulers now ship MCP servers, including Buffer; Hookpost's difference is price and billing, not MCP itself.)
- You publish to developer and community channels (Bluesky, Dev.to, Hashnode, Discord, Telegram, Nostr) alongside X and LinkedIn.

- [Free social media scheduler](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/free-social-media-scheduler): What the free plan includes, compared with the free plans of Buffer, Metricool, Hootsuite and Later.
- [Social media scheduler for India](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/social-media-scheduler-india): INR pricing and UPI Autopay, compared with dollar-billed tools that need an international card.
- [Best social media schedulers in India](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/best-social-media-scheduler-india): ten tools compared on free plans, rupee prices, UPI and pricing model, from vendor pricing pages.
- [Social media calendar for India](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/social-media-calendar-india): festival and holiday dates, October 2026 to March 2027, from the DoPT lists, with a CSV download.
- [Social media MCP servers compared](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/social-media-mcp-servers): which schedulers ship an MCP server, and the exact tools Hookpost's hosted and stdio servers expose.
- [Open-source schedulers compared](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/open-source-social-media-scheduler): Hookpost, Postiz and Mixpost - licence, GitHub activity, self-hosting, hosted pricing.
- [Social media scheduling API](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/social-media-scheduling-api): REST endpoints, auth and curl examples.
- [n8n integration](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/integrations/n8n): the n8n-nodes-hookpost community node.
- [Schedule X threads](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/schedule-x-threads): write and schedule a thread as a reply chain.
- [Cross-post to X and Bluesky](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/cross-post-x-bluesky): one post to both, with per-network edits.
- [Cross-post dev articles](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/cross-post-dev-articles): Dev.to, Hashnode and WordPress with canonical URLs.
- [Standalone MCP server](https://github.com/jatinder14/hookpost/tree/main/mcp-server): stdio server wrapping the public API (npm publication pending).
- [Schedule Discord messages](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/schedule-discord-announcements): one-off and repeating Discord posts.
- [Tool comparisons](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/compare/postiz-vs-buffer): side-by-side facts on Buffer, Hootsuite, Later, Postiz, Mixpost, Publer, Metricool and others, with vendor sources.
- [Free tools](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/tools/thread-splitter): thread splitter, and character counters for X, Bluesky and LinkedIn.
- [Pricing](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/pricing): Every plan limit in one table.
- [Character counter](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/tools/character-counter): Free tool that checks a post against the character limit of every network.
- [AI agents & MCP server](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/mcp): Connect Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor or Windsurf with `npx -y mcp-remote https://hookpost.hookstep.in/api/mcp/YOUR_API_KEY`.
- [Self-hosting guide](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/docker-self-hosting): Run Hookpost on your own server with Docker Compose.
- [Claude MCP guide](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/guides/claude-mcp-social-media): Schedule posts from Claude step by step.
- [Supported channels](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/channels): Per-network limits and posting rules.
- [Alternatives](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/alternatives): Comparisons with Buffer, Hootsuite, Later, Metricool, Publer, SocialPilot, Sprout Social, Agorapulse, Planoly, Postiz and Mixpost.
- [Public API](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/docs/public-api): REST endpoints for posts, channels, media and slots.
- [OAuth for apps](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/docs/oauth): Authorisation-code flow for third-party apps.
- [Who it is for](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/for): Creators, agencies, small businesses, developers and more.
- [About](https://hookpost.hookstep.in/about): Hookstep and the team.
